svg.aria-label: A grid of signal-controlled streets seen from above. Traffic stops and queues at red and pulls away on green; some vehicles are probe vehicles, shown pulsing as they report. On one stretch, a driver who has looked away past the first junction runs into the back of a queue waiting at the next red light, and the two vehicles tailgating behind cannot stop in time: a four-vehicle pile-up. The stretch flashes red from just before the first impact until the wreck is cleared, while the traffic behind backs up.
